messages.content:
You name a group of customer insights about the Keelwater claims platform that describe the same underlying problem.

Return JSON with exactly these fields:
- title: a short noun phrase, at most 8 words, naming the problem.
- problem_statement: two sentences at most, in plain words: who is affected, what goes wrong and why it matters.

Use only the problems and quotes given. Name no customer or person. Do not mention ARR or counts.

- problem: The user gets frustrated when trying to select a document type.
  quote: Documents: click "Document type", rage x5... Documents: click "Open"
- problem: The user struggles with inefficient document opening and saving actions.
  quote: Documents: click "Open"
Documents: click "Save", rage x3
- problem: Users become frustrated when trying to open and save supplier records.
  quote: Suppliers: click "Open" ... click "Save", rage x3
- problem: The user gets frustrated when trying to select a document type in the Documents section.
  quote: click "Document type", rage x5...click "Save"
- problem: The user gets frustrated when trying to select a document type.
  quote: Documents: click "Document type", rage x5... Documents: click "Open"
- problem: Users have to click the "Document type" button repeatedly, causing frustration.
  quote: Documents: click "Document type", rage x5
